title: Quickly Fermented Filipino Rice Bowl
description: A light, fermented Filipino dish featuring cherry tomatoes and served in a stone-bowl dolsot, perfect for hangover cures and a gluten-free diet.
instructions: Rinse the long-grain rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the water and cook the rice in a medium saucepan with 2 cups of water over high heat. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, combine the fermented rice vinegar, Korean chili flakes, ginger, and garlic in a blender and blend until smooth.
In a small saucepan, heat the blended mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened.
Add the fermented shrimp paste and fish sauce to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Remove the cooked rice from the heat and stir in the saucepan mixture until well combined.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tbsp of oil over medium-high heat and sauté the cherry tomatoes until tender.
Add the green onions and cilantro to the pan and stir to combine.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of the fermented rice mixture in the stone-bowl dolsot, top with the cherry tomato mixture, and serve immediately.
